relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN — the seeded id was faddeev_kashaev1994 and this document is NOT the work that key names. Front matter gives a different single author, a different arXiv identifier (arXiv:math/0604094v1 [math.QA]) and a different venue-era from the registered entry; identity reported separately to the caller. No existing key covers it (the two registered keys for this author are for different papers), so id is set to null and add-reference is the first action. ON THE MERITS the document is genuinely core to this folio, which is exactly why the wrong join matters: the mass-theory and QBeta chapters run on the Neumann-Zagier potential (neumann-zagier1985 is cited at ~40 sites) and on the quantum dilogarithm (faddeev_kashaev1994 at 9 sites), and this document is the bridge between them — it builds a quantum invariant Z_gamma(M) for a cusped hyperbolic 3-manifold by assigning the quantum dilogarithm to each ideal tetrahedron, shows the classical limit gamma -> 0 reproduces the Neumann-Zagier potential function, and derives the A-polynomial from that potential. That is precisely the Phi_q / AJ-machinery correspondence the corpus asserts at prop:phi-q-aj-machinery-identification and the deformed-cusp setting of conj:shared-denominator-cusp-holonomy.

keyResults.statement: For a cusped hyperbolic 3-manifold, the quantum invariant built by assigning the quantum dilogarithm to each ideal tetrahedron has the Neumann-Zagier potential function as its classical limit, and the A-polynomial is derived from that potential.
keyResults.useForFolio: Supplies a published derivation of the potential-from-quantum-dilogarithm link that the Phi_q / AJ identification asserts, and a literature anchor for the deformed-cusp (u-parameter) setting the shared-denominator conjecture works in.

proposedActions.rationale: The document has no ref() entry and the ledger currently mis-joins it to faddeev_kashaev1994. Create the entry from its own front matter before any citation is added.

prop:phi-q-aj-machinery-identification asserts the Phi_q to A-polynomial/AJ correspondence; this document derives the A-polynomial from the potential obtained as the classical limit of the quantum-dilogarithm state sum, which is the published form of that correspondence.
